ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Finance? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Finance.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Islamic Finance to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Islamic Finance has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc? (1 mark)
   A. Say Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc.
   D. Use Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq .
   B. Use Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of Sharia? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of Sharia with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Secondary sources of Sharia has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of Sharia.
   D. Use Secondary sources of Sharia to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf.
   C. Say The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Translation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Translation of the Qur’an.
   B. Apply the teaching of Translation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Translation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Translation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. Which response best shows understanding of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins.

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islam in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Influence of Islam in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Muslim Scholars Page 12 of 62 1 STRAND 1.0: STUDY OF THE QURAN AND HADITH and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Muslim scholars: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. B — Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. B — Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. C — Apply the teaching of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of Sharia with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. D — Apply the teaching of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Apply the teaching of Translation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. C — Apply the teaching of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Islam in Africa; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Muslim scholars:; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
